name: Cat Mischief
summary:
Welcome to Cat Mischief!🐱 This is a game where you move with your hands.

In this game, you traverse to different game modes, horror levels and so much more!

Shop - Customize yourself to look unique and stylish!

Game modes:
🍪Cookie Clicker - Click a Cookie and see how much you can get!
😱Horror - Explore through several sectors of a facility and don't get caught
🔍Glass Bridge - Find the REAL glass and not the weak one and reach the end!
🏃Chase - Practice chases for future levels for horror as it goes
